Experimental Setup

One lab, one rig, two projects

The Research Assistant (polymer photodetector) and M.S. thesis (MA₃Bi₂I₉ perovskite) projects were fabricated and measured on the same equipment at the FMOD Lab, LUMS. Rather than split identical equipment across two project pages, it's presented here once, by function.

Sample preparation

Deposition & substrate cleaning

Both the polymer and MA₃Bi₂I₉ active layers are deposited by spin coating on cleaned FTO substrates.

Samples & devices

Films and finished devices

Fabricated films and completed devices, staged for optoelectronic testing.

Measurement

Photocurrent characterization rig

Both projects used this setup: white light chopped by a rotating wheel, the device held at 0 V, and a transimpedance amplifier turning the photocurrent into a voltage.

Inspection

Film & device inspection

Quick optical checks between fabrication steps.

Tahir Sajjad Butt

Experimental physicist interested in device physics, optoelectronics, quantum materials and energy storage. Applying to Ph.D. programs for Fall 2027.
